# monero_node_module — Monero Node RPC

> Proxyable, fail-closed monerod JSON-RPC client. Per-network config (endpoint + proxy); socks5h/Tor-ready. Never runs a node itself; local mode dials the one monerod_module runs.

## API at a glance

| Method | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `set_node_config` | `set_node_config(network: tstr, config_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Store one network's config from `{ url, username?, password?, proxy?, proxyRequired?, timeoutSecs?, trusted?, mode? }`. |
| `get_node_config` | `get_node_config(network: tstr) -> tstr` |  |
| `effective_node` | `effective_node(network: tstr) -> tstr` | What a wallet dials: the stored config, or in local mode monerod_module's loopback URL, trusted and unproxied. |
| `local_node` | `local_node(network: tstr) -> tstr` | `{ ok, available, rpcUrl?, status?, error? }`: whether monerod_module can serve `network`. |
| `remove_node_config` | `remove_node_config(network: tstr) -> bool` |  |
| `list_networks` | `list_networks() -> tstr` | `{ ok, networks: [name, ...] }`. |
| `config_status` | `config_status() -> tstr` | `{ ok, state: "unready"¦"unconfigured"¦"configured", source, networks }`. |
| `init_defaults` | `init_defaults() -> tstr` | Seed well-known defaults per-field-if-absent. |
| `node_health` | `node_health(network: tstr) -> tstr` | `{ reachable, height, targetHeight, synced, restricted, rttMs, mode, local? }`. |
| `get_info` | `get_info(network: tstr) -> tstr` |  |
| `get_fee_estimate` | `get_fee_estimate(network: tstr) -> tstr` |  |
| `get_version` | `get_version(network: tstr) -> tstr` |  |
| `hard_fork_info` | `hard_fork_info(network: tstr) -> tstr` |  |
| `send_raw_transaction` | `send_raw_transaction(network: tstr, tx_as_hex: tstr) -> tstr` | Broadcast a signed tx blob via `/send_raw_transaction`. |
| `generateblocks` | `generateblocks(network: tstr, address: tstr, amount: int) -> tstr` | regtest only: mine `amount` blocks to `address`. |
| `raw_json_rpc` | `raw_json_rpc(network: tstr, method: tstr, params_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Escape hatch: an arbitrary `/json_rpc` method. |
| `raw_endpoint` | `raw_endpoint(network: tstr, path: tstr, body_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Escape hatch: an arbitrary "other" endpoint (POST `<url>/<path>`). |
